meta.title: Fix RealParent garbage collection warning to reduce noise in production apps
meta.body_summary: Fix noisy RealParent GC warnings by clearing weak references and optionally suppressing logging in production, with test coverage.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot iteratively refined GC warning fix with PureWeen guidance; PR closed after extensive instruction-tuning rather than merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 455 changed lines across 4 files, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume, though much churn came from adding/removing test files and copilot-instructions.md. The PR was closed after extensive review iterations, consistent with the outcome of an experimental process.

review_details.concern_detail: PureWeen CHANGES_REQUESTED to include fixes from PR #30156 and remove DEBUG conditional; then emphasized consolidating parent logic to eliminate duplication in SetParent and Parent.get.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce log noise and improve performance by clearing weak references and optionally suppressing warnings in non-debug builds.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer used PR as a test for Copilot instructions; after multiple resets and instruction updates, PR was closed without merge, likely because the process was experimental.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot's ability to follow iterative direction from maintainer was tested; it could respond to comments but required explicit resets to align with maintainer intentions, and contributed unrelated changes (copilot instructions). The PR served more as a training exercise than a mergeable fix.

detection_detail.code_reading: PureWeen reviewed the RealParent getter logic and identified duplication, requested integration with existing PR #30156 fixes.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Problem is reproducible by users; tests added to cover GC scenarios; no profiling or benchmark numbers provided.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After many iterations, PR closed; maintainer did not indicate regression, just stopped engagement.

core_change_summary.description: Modified Element.RealParent getter to clear weak reference when target collected, and introduced GetParent(bool) method to consolidate parent retrieval logic, avoiding duplicate warnings. Added unit tests for GC scenarios, then later removed separate test file and added to ElementTests.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: RealParentGCTests was initially added then removed in favor of ElementTests; copilot-instructions.md changes were unrelated to the fix.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added weak reference clearing and #if DEBUG conditional for warning (52b9c0)
Incorporated PR #30156 fixes and removed DEBUG conditional per review (1c5313)
Added copilot instruction guidance (f5545ed) not part of the fix
Multiple commits consolidating parent logic: first using Parent property, then GetRealParent(false), finally a GetParent(bool) method (3c3e7f, d27234, 6c61ce, 46a47c)
Restarted implementation multiple times per maintainer's testing of Copilot instructions (845fb0, a8e73b)
Final commit consolidated parent logic with GetParent(bool) method (46a47c)

review_signals.summary: Include the fixes from this PR #30156 but also improve the changes where you see fit to.
Remove this, we should log a warning in release builds as well.
Does this cause duplication of logic? Since we're also doing this inside Parent.get is there a way to consolidate that logic?
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot attempted multiple consolidation approaches across several commits.

review_signals.summary: Retrieving the Parent here shouldn't throw a warning, we want to check here if the Parent has been collected and if so we don't run the logic that's going to log a warning.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot changed SetParent to use GetRealParent(false) to avoid warning.

review_signals.summary: Can you consolidate the logic into a GetParent(bool logWarningIfParentHasBeenCollected) method?

collaboration_trajectory: PureWeen provided initial CHANGES_REQUESTED to integrate another PR.
Copilot made multiple iterations over several days, with maintainer guiding on design and testing Copilot's instruction-following.
The PR was eventually closed without merge after the maintainer stopped providing feedback.
